page.layout: One printed page. Woodcut ornament frieze at top, then heading in capitals with a second line beneath; below, a large woodcut initial A at left with running text in one column to the right and below it. Page number at top right. Signature at foot.

main_text.head: LECTORI CHRISTIANO, Salutem.
main_text.p: ASsertionum siue Thesewn Posnaniensium de Ecclesia auctor Arturus, societatis, quā Iesuiticam blaphemè vocant, sectator tres libros emisit, quibus illarum Analysin & Refutationem oppugnat: ea duntaxat reponens argumenta quæ à Turriano & aliis eiusmodi propofita, iam ita fuerūt antè refutata, ut Christiano Lectori negotium nunc amplius facesse re non debeant. Veruntamē quum Nobilissimi viri P.M. Domini An-
main_text.notes: The large initial A is a woodcut; the opening word is set as "ASSERTIO-" with the initial, read as "Assertionum". Several words in the first lines are doubtful, notably "Thesewn" (Greek ϲέων rendered as "seɷn"), "Posnaniensium", and "blaphemè". The line "Nobilissimi viri P.M. Domini An-" is continued on the next page. The page number "3" is printed top right, in a worn figure.
